daily.brief: 過去約26小時有235則相關帖、來自78個帳號。最大變化是Nvidia執行長黃仁勳個人關係醜聞傳開，盤後股價跌約8%，本周市值損失大約6000億美元，市場開始討論董事會是否會行動。共識明顯偏向AMD會受惠領導真空，GOOGL也接近超越成為市值第三。NVDA本身意見分裂，有人認為他像Elon一樣不可替代，有人則擔心後果。
daily.full:
共識

AMD成為最大受惠者。@wallstengine提到William Blair上調至Outperform，理由正是Nvidia潛在領導真空，預期2027年營收增長超80%，數據中心AI營收第四季會超越伺服器CPU。原帖。@EliteOptions2更直接，盤後AMD升25+，目標看到600，而NVDA可能再跌至153。原帖。

GOOGL也有聲音支持。@DeItaone引HSBC「不要浪費一個好的拋售」，把Alphabet列為買入。原帖。@Mr_Derivatives指出GOOGL接近超越NVDA成為世界第三大公司，幾週前Nvidia還是第一。原帖。

共同看淡

這段時間沒有明顯的共同看淡股票。

分歧

NVDA是最熱，120次提及。@Mr_Derivatives說玩笑話不談，終究仍需要GPU推動AI革命，NVDA最終會走出困境。原帖。@aleabitoreddit不同意移除黃仁勳，認為他幾乎不可替代，就像拿掉Elon對TSLA一樣，估值與信心會崩潰，他對CUDA、供應鏈的遠見難找。原帖。但@Frenchie_詳述與Kimberly Powell的第二段關係，董事會可能開會罷免，盤後已跌8%。原帖。@daniel_koss則分析董事會11人需要6票才能移除，創始忠誠者賺了不少，認為保留他符合經濟利益。原帖。

MU也有分歧。@TradexWhisperer看到從667升到828約24%，技術指標支持繼續持有。原帖。@themissinglinks認為NVDA下跌時記憶體股是線索，可以買入。原帖。但有人把MU下跌跟NVDA醜聞綁在一起。

其他值得留意

ONDS業績雙重超預期，收入1.68億對預期1.48億，積壓訂單約8.35億，@StockSavvyShay和@PhotonBull都看好。原帖。MNTS在太空機器人組裝有進展，戰爭部合約下有DARPA相關載荷。原帖。NBIS有人覺得131美元是便宜貨，但也有下跌近15%的觀察。
daily.html:
短摘要

NVDA黃仁勳醜聞主導今日討論，盤後大跌，AMD與GOOGL受惠聲音較多。235則帖、78帳號中，NVDA提及120次意見分裂，AMD有明確看好共識。

weekly.brief: 過去7日407則帖、103個帳號。AMD持續是共識看好標的，有8個帳號明確看好，GOOGL、APP等也有支持。NVDA仍是最大熱點（164提及）但意見分裂，沒有明顯共同看淡。市場整體對AI相關股票反應不一，記憶體和雲端也有交鋒。
weekly.full:
共識

AMD在這週持續獲看好，William Blair等上調，認為領導真空有利，AI業務會加速。GOOGL、AVGO、META、ONDS等也有多個帳號支持。LITE、COHR等光學相關也有聲音。

共同看淡

這週沒有明顯的共同看淡股票。

分歧

NVDA依舊分裂。有人堅持GPU需求不會因為個人事件消失，黃仁勳的遠見難取代；有人則聚焦董事會可能行動和市值蒸發。MU、NBIS、QQQ、SPY、TSLA、SPCX都有多空交錯，記憶體股被視為NVDA波動的領先指標，有人買入有人觀望。

其他值得留意

太空相關如ASTS、LUNR有進展討論，BE等也有支持。整體AI資本支出故事未變，但短期情緒被個人新聞干擾。
weekly.html:
短摘要

一週內AMD是最明確的共識看好，NVDA大分歧持續。407則帖中AI鏈條反應不一，沒有共同看淡。

monthly.brief: 過去28日5748則帖、195個帳號，討論量最大。AMD、SOFI等有較強共識看好，RDDT、BA等有共同看淡。大市SPY、NVDA、TSLA、SPCX意見分裂嚴重，CRWV和INTC則偏空聲音較多。AI主題仍是主軸，但個別公司事件和估值分歧明顯。
monthly.full:
共識

AMD長期仍獲支持，多個帳號看好其AI機會。SOFI、SKHY、RSP等也有多個看好聲音。一些消費和防禦股如MA、ISRG、LMT、MCD有共識。

共同看淡

RDDT有9個帳號看淡，BA、FTNT、BABA、RBLX等也有較一致的負面看法。

分歧

SPY、NVDA、SPCX、TSLA是最大分歧，提及數百次。有人認為AI資本支出故事未變，短期恐懼會過去；有人擔心估值和個別風險。CRWV偏空聲音較多（20看淡對4看好），INTC也是。MU多空均衡。

其他值得留意

NBIS、PLTR、AVGO等AI相關持續有討論。市場輪動和個股事件影響較大。
monthly.html:
短摘要

28日大數據中AMD等有共識，RDDT等被看淡。SPY和NVDA等大票意見分裂，AI主題延續但分歧加大。

briefing.html:
今日重點

NVDA執行長個人醜聞主導討論，盤後大跌8%，本周市值損失約6000億。AMD成為明確受惠者，有目標價600的聲音，GOOGL也接近超越成為第三大。意見在「黃仁勳不可替代」與「董事會可能行動」之間拉鋸。ONDS業績超預期、MNTS太空進展也有人留意。

一週和一個月來看，AMD共識較強，大市和AI龍頭則持續分歧。沒有明顯共同看淡在短期。

daily.brief: Over the past ~26 hours there were 235 relevant posts from 78 accounts. The biggest shift is the personal relationship scandal involving Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang spreading, with the stock down about 8% after hours and roughly $600 billion in market cap lost this week. Consensus leans toward AMD benefiting from any leadership vacuum, while GOOGL is nearing the No. 3 spot by market cap. Views on NVDA itself are split between those who see him as irreplaceable like Elon and those worried about board action.
daily.full:
Consensus

AMD is the clear beneficiary. @wallstengine notes William Blair upgrading to Outperform on the potential Nvidia leadership vacuum, expecting over 80% revenue growth in 2027 and data center AI revenue surpassing server CPU by Q4. original post. @EliteOptions2 is more direct: AMD up 25+ after hours with a target toward 600, while NVDA could fall further to 153. original post.

GOOGL also draws support. @DeItaone cites HSBC saying "don't waste a good sell-off" and listing Alphabet as a buy. original post. @Mr_Derivatives points out GOOGL is close to overtaking NVDA as the world's third-largest company. original post.

Joint Bearish

No clear joint bearish names in this window.

Divergence

NVDA dominates with 120 mentions. @Mr_Derivatives says jokes aside, GPUs are still needed for the AI revolution and NVDA will eventually move past this. original post. @aleabitoreddit disagrees with removing Jensen, calling him nearly irreplaceable like removing Elon from TSLA. original post. Meanwhile @Frenchie_ details the second relationship with Kimberly Powell and possible board removal, with the stock already down 8% after hours. original post.

Other Notable

ONDS beat on earnings with revenue of $168M vs $148M expected. MNTS reported progress on space robotic assembly under a DoD contract. NBIS has both "cheap at 131" and "down nearly 15%" takes.
daily.html:
Short summary

Jensen Huang scandal dominates today's discussion. AMD and GOOGL draw more supportive voices. Among 235 posts and 78 accounts, NVDA's 120 mentions show clear split views.

weekly.brief: Over the past 7 days: 407 posts from 103 accounts. AMD remains the clearest consensus long with 8 accounts explicitly bullish. GOOGL, APP and others also see support. NVDA is still the hottest name (164 mentions) but views stay split. No clear joint bearish names.
weekly.full:
Consensus

AMD continues to attract positive views on the leadership vacuum thesis and AI upside. GOOGL, AVGO, META, ONDS and several optical names also have multiple supporters.

Joint Bearish

No clear joint bearish names this week.

Divergence

NVDA remains divided between those who see GPU demand as durable and those focused on board risk. MU, NBIS, QQQ, SPY, TSLA and SPCX all show mixed takes, with memory stocks sometimes treated as a leading indicator.

Other Notable

Space names such as ASTS and LUNR continue to draw interest. The broader AI capex story is unchanged but short-term sentiment is noisy.
weekly.html:
Short summary

AMD is the clearest consensus long over the week. NVDA divergence continues. 407 posts show mixed AI-chain reactions with no joint bearish names.

monthly.brief: Over the past 28 days: 5748 posts from 195 accounts. AMD and SOFI show relatively strong consensus support while RDDT and BA draw more consistent negative views. Large names such as SPY, NVDA, TSLA and SPCX remain heavily split. CRWV and INTC lean more bearish.
monthly.full:
Consensus

AMD retains longer-term support on AI opportunity. SOFI, SKHY and several other names also have multiple bullish accounts. Some consumer and defense names show agreement.

Joint Bearish

RDDT has 9 bearish accounts. BA, FTNT, BABA and RBLX also see more aligned negative takes.

Divergence

SPY, NVDA, SPCX and TSLA are the largest split names with hundreds of mentions. Some argue the AI capex story is intact and fear will fade; others focus on valuation and company-specific risks. CRWV shows more bearish voices (20 bear vs 4 bull).

Other Notable

NBIS, PLTR and AVGO remain active in AI discussions. Rotation and single-stock events continue to matter.
monthly.html:
Short summary

In the 28-day window AMD and others have consensus support while RDDT draws bearish views. SPY and NVDA remain split. AI theme persists but divergence is wider.

briefing.html:
Today's brief

The Jensen Huang personal scandal dominates discussion. NVDA is down ~8% after hours with roughly $600B in market cap lost this week. AMD is the clear beneficiary with a 600 target mentioned, and GOOGL is close to becoming the third-largest company. Views split between "Jensen is irreplaceable" and "the board may act." ONDS earnings beat and MNTS space progress also drew attention.

Over the week and month, AMD shows stronger consensus while broad market and AI leaders remain split. No clear joint bearish names in the short term.
